content_of_post_to_answer: What do mentally strong people not do? How do you build mental toughness?
answer: Mentally strong people are not those who never struggle; they are people who stop adding unnecessary battles to the ones they already face. They don't waste energy defending every decision, proving their worth, or controlling what others think. A subtle part of toughness is knowing what deserves your attention and what doesn't. Resilience is not just enduring more pain; it is becoming selective about which pain you choose to carry.
